title: Latchfog Nullfield
text: A reflective fog unfastens every practiced tool from its purpose. On failure, suffer 1 Wound and fix this Hazard to the sector. While fixed, equipped Gear contributes no stat bonuses to the first Threat resolved on each arrival.
flavor: Your hands remember the tool. The tool remembers someone else.

successEffect.text: You pinned the false reflections and recovered the nullfield's anchor.
